facts.note: At the temple's strike of nine, the husband had everyone show their watches; Félix's showed twenty minutes to nine and Aurèle scolded him.
Piquet in the salon without a break; the temple struck ten during play; play continued until he went out for cigars; she did not look at the clock when he left.
He asked her to play as he went out; she sat at the piano at once and played until he returned, stopping when he came in.
A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.
